title: Course For Teachers
description:
Welcome Teachers!

We’re excited that you will be part of the program in guiding your student through it.

Now it’s time to start the program.

We would like you all to go through the following in order.

  1. Watch the Instructional Videos for overview of the program.
  2. Read the Teacher handbook for a summary of the course and other important instructions.
  3. Take the Teacher Quiz for recall.
  4. Introduce the program to students and motivate them to participate.
  5. Register interested student teams on the platform.
  6. Support students team as they explore the platform and understand the program.

You have one week to do these. Afterwards, you and your students will be ready to start their problem solving journey!

We hope you enjoy guiding the students as they embark on this new journey!

Wishing you all the best!
